speaker: NARRATOR
text: [excited, hushed] What if you could see everyone's stats... in real life?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [playful] Your teacher? Level ninety-nine. [pause] Final boss.

speaker: TEACHER
text: [cold] Homework. [pause] On my desk. [pause] NOW.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [playful] The school bully? Level eighty. [pause] But his health... is almost zero.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [fast, playful] Your little brother? Chaos: nine thousand, nine hundred ninety-nine.

speaker: MAX
text: [tiny voice, excited] RAWR!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] The lunch lady? Level fifty. [pause] Secret skill: mystery meat.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [softly] You could see everybody's stats. [pause] Everybody's... except yours.

speaker: YOU
text: [confused] Question marks? [pause] Why do I get QUESTION MARKS?!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] Okay. Let's start from the beginning.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [storyteller] This is you. You love games. Because in games, everything makes sense.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Every enemy has a level. Every item has stats. [pause] You always know who's strong.

speaker: YOU
text: [proud] Level fifty goblin? Easy. [pause] Level ninety dragon? Run.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [sighs] But real life? Real life has no numbers. [pause] You never know what anyone is thinking.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: There's Mom. She runs a bakery. She works all day... and she always smiles.

speaker: MOM
text: [cheerful, tired] Morning, sweetheart! Breakfast is ready! [pause] Probably.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: She baked three hundred cupcakes before sunrise. [pause] And she still asked about your day.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: There's Grandpa Lou. Every breakfast, he tells the same story.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [proud, old] Nineteen seventy-nine! The arm wrestling finals! I was a legend!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: There's Max. Your little brother. He's five. [pause] He's basically a tornado in a dinosaur suit.

speaker: MAX
text: [tiny voice] I'm a T-rex! [pause] RAWR!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [warmly] And Biscuit. Biscuit is a very good boy. That's his whole job.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [proud, old] Did I tell you about seventy-nine?

speaker: YOU
text: [deadpan] Every day, Grandpa. [pause] Every. Single. Day.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: At school, there's Benji. Your best friend. [pause] He's bad at sports. Bad at math. Bad at shoelaces.

speaker: BENJI
text: [cheerful, nervous] I'm okay! [pause] I'm okay! I meant to do that!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [warmly] But he's the nicest person you know.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And then there's Tank. [pause] Nobody knows much about Tank. [pause] Except that he's big. And he's always hungry.

speaker: TANK
text: [low, gruff] Lunch. [pause] Now.

speaker: YOU
text: [nervous] Sure. Yep. [pause] Enjoy. It's turkey.

speaker: BENJI
text: [whispering] One day, we'll stand up to him. [pause] Probably not today. But one day.

speaker: YOU
text: [frustrated] If only I knew how strong everyone REALLY was.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [ominous] Be careful what you wish for.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [calm] Update available. [pause] Reality HUD, version one point zero.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: That night, a strange update popped up. [pause] Terms and conditions: four thousand, eight hundred and twelve pages.

speaker: YOU
text: [casual] Accept. [pause] Nobody reads those.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] Nobody reads those.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: Installing... [pause] reality.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The next morning... everything had stats.

speaker: YOU
text: [amazed] My bed has stats. My SOCK has stats. [pause] My alarm clock is an ENEMY?!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] The toaster had an eighty percent chance to burn. [pause] It burned.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Mom was smiling. [pause] Her energy was two percent.

speaker: MOM
text: [cheerful, tired] Good morning, sweetheart!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] Each coffee gave her one percent. [pause] She drank four. [pause] Six percent. A new record.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Grandpa was level eighty-seven. [pause] And Max had infinite health.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [suspicious, old] Why are you staring at the top of my head?

speaker: YOU
text: [quickly] No reason! [pause] Nice... hair, Grandpa.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [deadpan] I don't have hair.

speaker: MAX
text: [tiny voice, shouting] Watch this!

speaker: YOU
text: [whispering, amazed] This... is... AMAZING.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] Biscuit's stats didn't even load. [pause] Error. Too good.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: School was a whole new game.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Benji was level four. [pause] His special skill was "falling down."

speaker: BENJI
text: [cheerful] Hey, buddy! [pause] Whoa— I'm okay!

speaker: TEACHER
text: [cold] Who forgot their homework?

speaker: KID
text: [nervous] My dog ate it!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] You could see lies now. [pause] That one was ninety-nine percent.

speaker: TEACHER
text: [cold] Pop quiz. [pause] Twenty questions.

speaker: YOU
text: [whispering, scared] Difficulty... impossible.

speaker: BENJI
text: [whispering] Is that bad? [pause] That sounds bad.

speaker: TEACHER
text: [cold] Is there something on my head?

speaker: YOU
text: [nervous] No, ma'am! [pause] Just your... very nice... level.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: In dodgeball, you picked your team by strength. [pause] Science. Pure science.

speaker: YOU
text: [confident] You. And you. [pause] And definitely you, eighty-five strength.

speaker: KID
text: [confused] You picked the quiet kid FIRST?

speaker: YOU
text: [smug] Trust me. [pause] He has a secret.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You won. Every single game.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Even lunch had stats. [pause] The mystery meat just said "question mark."

speaker: BENJI
text: [nervous] Should we eat it?

speaker: YOU
text: [firm] Benji. It says QUESTION MARK.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And above some people... there were little yellow marks. [pause] Like in a game.

speaker: YOU
text: [curious] Quests? [pause] Real life has QUESTS?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Then Tank came for your lunch. [pause] Level eighty. [pause] A boss fight.

speaker: YOU
text: [panicked, whispering] Run? Fight? Hide under the table?

speaker: TANK
text: [low, gruff] Lunch.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: But then you saw it. [pause] Three health. Hungry. Tired. [pause] Lonely.

speaker: YOU
text: [quietly] ...He hasn't eaten all day.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And above his head... a tiny question mark.

speaker: YOU
text: [gently] Here. [pause] Take the whole thing. I'm not that hungry.

speaker: TANK
text: [confused] ...You're GIVING it to me?

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [cheerful] Quest complete! [pause] Plus thirty-seven health.

speaker: TANK
text: [quietly, confused] Thanks... I guess.

speaker: YOU
text: [carefully] Tank? [pause] Why do you always take people's lunch?

speaker: TANK
text: [quietly, embarrassed] My dad works nights. [pause] Nobody makes me lunch. [pause] Okay? Don't tell anybody.

speaker: YOU
text: [kind] My mom always makes way too much. [pause] You can have half. Every day.

speaker: BENJI
text: [amazed] Did Tank just say THANKS?!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And that's when you learned the rule. [pause] Kindness gives people health. [pause] And it gives YOU experience.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: Experience plus fifty! [pause] Level up!

speaker: YOU
text: [excited] I'm leveling UP? [pause] For being NICE?!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: So you went on a quest spree.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You carried groceries. You complimented the lunch lady. [pause] You rescued a ball from a tree.

speaker: YOU
text: [cheerful, fast] Nice hat, Mrs. Wells! [pause] Great soup, lunch lady! [pause] Cool dog, random man!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Level two. Level five. Level twenty.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Every day, you shared your lunch with Tank. [pause] Forty health. Sixty. Eighty.

speaker: TANK
text: [low, almost smiling] Your mom makes good sandwiches.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [grumpy, old] Has anybody seen my glasses?

speaker: YOU
text: [deadpan] Grandpa. [pause] They're on your head.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [cheerful] Quest complete. [pause] Plus one experience.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] Easiest quest in history.

speaker: MAX
text: [tiny voice] Build me a pillow fort! The biggest one EVER!

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [cheerful] Epic quest complete! [pause] Plus one hundred experience!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [slower] But slowly... you stopped helping people. [pause] You started helping points.

speaker: YOU
text: [dismissive] Two XP? [pause] Not worth it.

speaker: TEACHER
text: [cold] Science fair. Partners. [pause] Choose wisely.

speaker: BENJI
text: [excited] Partners again? I have an idea! A potato battery!

speaker: YOU
text: [awkward] Actually, Benji... I'm working with them. [pause] They have ninety-five intelligence.

speaker: BENJI
text: [hurt, quiet] Since when do you care about levels?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [quietly] That number hurt more than any other.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Your new partners were very smart. [pause] They talked only about numbers. [pause] They never laughed once.

speaker: YOU
text: [quietly] ...This is boring.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: At home, Mom had a quest. [pause] "Help Mom. Five XP."

speaker: YOU
text: [distracted] Sorry, Mom. Gotta go. [pause] There's a fifty-XP quest down the street.

speaker: MOM
text: [tired, smiling] It's okay, sweetheart. I'm fine.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: She said she was fine. [pause] Her energy said one percent.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [quietly] Kid. [pause] What are you really looking at?

speaker: YOU
text: [defensive] Stats, Grandpa. [pause] Stats don't lie.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [quietly] Maybe not. [pause] But they don't tell the whole truth, either.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Saturday. The town fair. [pause] Mom's first day off in a year.

speaker: MOM
text: [happy, tired] Everybody stay together, okay?

speaker: MAX
text: [tiny voice, excited] I wanna go UP! Way up! [pause] Where the clouds are!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Max wanted to go up. [pause] Remember that. It's important.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: But there were thousands of people. [pause] And thousands of numbers.

speaker: YOU
text: [worried] Wait. [pause] Where's Max?

speaker: MOM
text: [panicked] Max? MAX!

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [glitchy] New quest. [pause] Find Max. [pause] Location... unknown.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [glitchy, alarm] Warning. Too many players. [pause] HUD overload.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [tense] You looked everywhere. But all you could see... were numbers.

speaker: YOU
text: [panicked] Level twelve! Level forty! Level eight! [pause] I can't see FACES!

speaker: MOM
text: [panicked] He's wearing a dinosaur suit! [pause] A green dinosaur!

speaker: YOU
text: [panicked] I can't tell! Everybody's just... a number!

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [quietly] You could see everyone's stats. [pause] But you couldn't see your brother.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [calm, old] Breathe, kid. [pause] Sit with me for one second.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [warm] You know my story. Nineteen seventy-nine. The finals. [pause] But I never told you the end.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [smiling] I lost. [pause] Lost the final. In front of everybody.

speaker: YOU
text: [surprised] You... LOST?

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [laughing softly] Arm went down in two seconds. [pause] The whole town laughed.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [warm] And that night, I met your grandma. [pause] Best loss of my whole life.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [gently] Numbers tell you how strong somebody is. [pause] They don't tell you who they are.

speaker: YOU
text: [quietly] I think I stopped seeing people, Grandpa. [pause] I only saw numbers.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [curious] Hey. What's that little X up in the corner?

speaker: YOU
text: [stunned] ...An X?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [deadpan] It was on page one. [pause] Of four thousand, eight hundred and twelve.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [calm] Reality HUD... off.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [softly] No numbers. [pause] Just colors. And sounds. [pause] And faces.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And you didn't need stats to know your brother.

speaker: YOU
text: [focused] Max loves dinosaurs. [pause] He says "rawr" at everything. [pause] And he always wants to be up high.

speaker: BENJI
text: [out of breath] I heard! I know the fair map! [pause] I've been here eleven times!

speaker: TANK
text: [low, kind] I'm tall. [pause] Get on.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You ran past the Ferris wheel. Past the cotton candy. [pause] Past the giant teacups.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The kid with level four. The kid with three health. [pause] And you.

speaker: BENJI
text: [focused] Not the Ferris wheel. Max hates the Ferris wheel. It's too slow.

speaker: TANK
text: [low] Cotton candy? [pause] Every kid goes to cotton candy.

speaker: YOU
text: [thinking] No. [pause] Max doesn't want sweets. Max wants to be a DINOSAUR. [pause] Up high.

speaker: YOU
text: [shouting] THERE! On top of the dinosaur!

speaker: MAX
text: [tiny voice, happy] RAWR!

speaker: YOU
text: [relieved, laughing] Found you, T-rex.

speaker: MAX
text: [tiny voice, proud] I was the king of the dinosaurs! [pause] RAWR!

speaker: MOM
text: [crying, happy] Don't you EVER do that again!

speaker: MAX
text: [tiny voice] ...Can we do it again?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The next morning, you made breakfast. [pause] Without checking anyone's energy.

speaker: YOU
text: [warm] Sit down, Mom. [pause] I can see you're tired. [pause] With my eyes.

speaker: MOM
text: [touched] ...Thank you, sweetheart.

speaker: BENJI
text: [excited] It works! [pause] Kind of! A little!

speaker: YOU
text: [laughing] Best partner ever.

speaker: YOU
text: [sincere] Benji... I'm sorry. [pause] You're not level four. You're my best friend.

speaker: BENJI
text: [touched] Thanks. [pause] ...Level four is still pretty good though, right?

speaker: TANK
text: [shy] Can I... sit here?

speaker: YOU
text: [cheerful] Always.

speaker: TANK
text: [shy, smiling] I brought my own lunch today. [pause] My dad made it. [pause] It's... mostly ketchup.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [warm, old] Told you, kid. [pause] Best things in life don't have numbers.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You turned the HUD on one last time. [pause] Just to check one thing.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [cheerful] Pet stats enabled.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [playful] Biscuit. Level one thousand. [pause] Good boy: infinite.

speaker: GRANDPA
text: [laughing, old] Level one thousand? [pause] That dog has never done anything!

speaker: MAX
text: [tiny voice] He's a GOOD BOY, Grandpa!

speaker: MAX
text: [tiny voice, proud] I KNEW it!

speaker: MAX
text: [tiny voice, curious] What does yours say?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [softly] For the first time, your stats loaded. [pause] No level. No numbers. [pause] Just two words.

speaker: YOU
text: [warm] ..."Big brother." [pause] That's a good stat.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [warmly] So... if you could see one stat above everyone's head... what would it be? [pause] Tell me in the comments!
